The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock left. The full `mvn -q -o test` run finished with no output, so I take that as passing.

The change is one added condition, `AND s.quantity > 0`, in the query in `DataStore.listStockLevelsInWarehouse` (`DataStore.java`, around line 1491). In your example, WH-1 would show only "Bolt 10".

I didn't touch the single-product quantity lookup (`SELECT quantity FROM stock WHERE warehouse_id = ? AND product_id = ?`), so asking for nuts in WH-1 should still answer 0. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case.
